author: New China TV
description:
What is it like to float down the Yellow River on a raft made of sheepskin? In Lanzhou, visitors can sit just above the water, follow the current and experience a traditional way of traveling along the Yellow River.
Come with us for a close-up encounter with the Yellow River -- on a sheepskin raft.
#Lanzhou #YellowRiver #SheepskinRaft #Gansu #TravelChina
title: Adventures Along the Silk Road | Floating Down the Yellow River on a Sheepskin Raft

author: New China TV
description:
Extreme heat, strong winds and low humidity are fueling record-breaking wildfires across Spain and France, burning vast areas of land and forcing hundreds of thousands of people to evacuate or remain indoors.
Expert warns that climate change could make highly unpredictable "sixth-generation fires," which are capable of generating their own winds, increasingly common and harder to predict and control.
#Wildfires #Spain #France #ExtremeWeather #ClimateChange #BreakingNews
title: Spain, France battle unprecedented wildfires

title: Police rescue teen trapped in tidal mud

title: How panda cub beats heat in China's "furnace city"

description: How does porcelain carry stories across time and cultures? From broken pieces and export porcelain to modern creations, discover the craftsmanship, people, and connections behind the enduring legacy of Jingdezhen, China's "porcelain capital." The Jingdezhen Handicraft Porcelain Industry Sites have been inscribed on UNESCO's World Heritage List. #AskJingdezhen #JingdezhenPorcelain #CeramicArt #CulturalExchange #ChinaStories #WorldHeritageList
title: Ask Jingdezhen | How has porcelain bridged time and cultures?

author: New China TV
description: Wuhan is known as one of China's "furnace cities." But inside Ganlushan International Ski Resort, the biggest indoor snow complex in central China, it's a refreshing minus 6 degrees Celsius all year round. This massive winter-like wonderland offers pro trails, a snow park, and fun for all ages. Beyond the thrill, it reflects China's booming winter sports culture and growing fitness trend. (recorded)
title: Giant indoor ski resort offers summer relief in China's "furnace city"

author: New China TV
description:
What would a Chinese ink painting look like if it were shaped by nature? Just outside Lanzhou, capital city of northwest China's Gansu Province, layers of red, gold and gray stretch across the mountains, creating a landscape known as the Shuimo (Ink-Wash) Danxia.
Come with us as we step into a landscape painted by earth, wind and time. #ShuimoDanxia #Gansu #SilkRoad #TravelChina
title: Adventures along the silk road | Walking through an ink painting in northwest China's Gansu
